thread:
Olivia: Heads-up - billing dashboard showing embedding unit spike that lines up with the v3 clientlib rollout window. top 5 tenants only.
Sam: I pulled the event shapes. v3 sometimes omits content_type and includes billing_context.kind="embedding". transform currently prefers content_type -> default text when missing. possible misclassification.
Ravi: Reproduced locally. sample event: {billing_context:{kind:"embedding",dims:1536}, content_type:null} -> transform maps unit_type=text_tokens.
Marta: That would funnel events into the text bucket then later enrichment flips them to embedding in downstream joins, leading to duplicate-looking counts in preview dashboards.
Olivia: Short-term: patch transform to check billing_context.kind first when present. long-term: normalize clientlib contract.
Sam: I'll make a Grafana card that shows embedding_units vs embedding_charges and a per-tenant delta metric. wire an alert at >2% divergence.
Ravi: I'll open a tiny PR with the mapping rule and add a metric transform.classify.pref_billing_context. gate under feature flag and canary 5%.
Marta: Finance wants a reconciliation query and a list of affected tenants. Draft SQL uploaded to FIN-490.
Olivia: Rollout plan: canary 5% -> monitor 30m -> 25% -> 100% unless any tenant >$500/day shows >1% invoice delta. backfill only for whitelist tenants and tag reprocessed rows with reprocess=true.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: transform/prefer-billing-context -> canary (5%) commit 9f8b2c in 4m.
metering-bot: Alert (info): billing.unit_mix panel shows +9% embedding_charge_count at 09:12 UTC (aggregate).
Sam: Aggregate alert confirmed. per-canary tenants stable. sounds like backlog historical events surfacing.
Ravi: Canary deploy done. initial metric shows ~0.05% classification overrides.
Marta: I've notified CS and Finance. CS prepared templated notes in case customers ask.
Olivia: OK. Ravi run the backfill for top-8 tenants tonight with rate-limited job and write to staging_ledger. Tag events reprocess=true. Sam, add the per-tenant delta dashboard before backfill runs.
Ravi: Will do. backfill ETA 2h, will post status here.
Sam: Dashboard updated and alert wired.
Olivia: Thanks team. I'll own postmortem and follow-up to update client contract docs so content_type is required or we document precedence. Keep updates in this thread.
